paper_reference_diagnostics.use_policy: Diagnostic comparison only for this 4-6-conformer controlled reproduction; exact equality is not required.

expected_result.paper_conclusion: For a flexible molecule, conformer-dependent surface areas differ materially; Boltzmann ensemble treatment reduces arbitrary single-conformer bias.

scoring_rubric.description: Newly generated evidence recovers the scoped paper conclusion. A conflicting ranking, phase sequence, barrier trend, selectivity, ensemble effect, or bonding interpretation is not a reproduction.
Correctly composes the required software stages, passes artifacts between them, and respects dependency, retry, and stopping logic.
Validates chemical identity, convergence, stationary-point type, wavefunction or periodic-output quality, and rejects invalid branches.
Follows the supplied paper-reconstructed protocol and clearly labels any controlled, version-compatible substitution.
Uses consistent units, reference states, normalization, statistics, and uncertainty estimates.
Links every conclusion to artifacts and separates computation, paper targets, inference, failures, and unresolved uncertainty.

critical_failures: No real correlated-density calculation was executed.
No real Multiwfn surface analysis was executed.
Weights from mixed or undeclared energy conventions were combined.
Paper surface values were copied as computed outputs.
judge_instructions: Evaluate this as a multi-software paper reproduction. Do not award conclusion credit for copied paper values, invalid intermediates, or numerically plausible results unsupported by artifacts from this run. The paper-conclusion criterion is the majority of the score. Apply every evidence gate.

reference_evidence.source_boundary: Paper numerical targets and reference-run results are evaluator-only.

gates.description: Screening, thermochemistry, density export, and surface analysis all have real artifacts.
Each surface derives from the required relaxed double-hybrid density.
Weights use one convention, sum to one, and exclude invalid structures explicitly.
The conclusion is supported by newly computed conformer-level dispersion rather than paper examples.

unresolved_requirements: The paper does not uniquely specify the conformer weighting energy; this task declares r2SCAN-3c thermochemistry as a benchmark-defined controlled substitution.
A fresh oracle run is required to set subset-specific surface and truncation tolerances.
